usedFor: Slack is where requests get posted, and TeamWave turns each one into work through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Create Task” in TeamWave
bestTemplate.why: A message in a chosen Slack channel becomes a TeamWave task, so requests stop getting lost in chat.

watchOut: It also catches bot messages, so a busy channel can create tasks you did not mean to track.
